title: Fix the Do-While Off-By-One
description: The program should print numbers 1 through 3 using a do-while loop.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 1, 2, 3 and then stop.
actualProblem: The loop condition i <= 4 allows one extra pass, so the loop also prints 4 before stopping, producing one number more than intended.
explanation: A do-while loop checks its condition after each iteration, so the boundary value used in the condition must exactly match the last value that should actually be printed — here, 3, not 4.
